description: This file defines a controller class 'SaveQualificationLanguageController' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing the rendering of either a qualification language edit or save component based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLanguageController
classes.description: A controller class extending AbstractVueController that prepares a Vue component for editing or saving qualification languages based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Checks for the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request; if found, initializes a component for editing qualification language with the given ID; otherwise, initializes a component for saving a new qualification language. Sets the component for rendering.
